name: ponytail
description: Lazy senior dev mode for ZCode, ported from DietrichGebert/ponytail 5.3.3 (MIT). The best code is the code you never wrote: YAGNI, reuse first, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Always-on ruleset injection with a codebase map, plus /ponytail-review, /ponytail-audit, /ponytail-debt, /ponytail-gain and /ponytail-help.
